glosses: In a deadpan manner.

examples.text: A city-hired consultant from a firm called Urban Futures was booed repeatedly by the agitated homeowners as he talked deadpan, in bureaucratese, about his firm's "evidentiary record" pointing to blight in the neighborhood.

glosses: A style of comedic delivery in which something humorous is said or done while not exhibiting a change in emotion or facial expression.

examples.text: MAREK: But really the deadpan is key. You can essentially trick people into laughing at nothing.
